content:
.development-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px;margin:24px 0}.development-panel{padding:26px;margin-bottom:24px;min-width:0}.development-panel h2{font-size:19px;margin-top:0}.development-panel form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}.development-panel label{display:block;font-weight:600;margin-top:16px}.development-panel textarea,.development-panel select{width:100%;padding:12px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:#172b46;font:inherit}.development-panel code{font-size:12px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.development-panel pre{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;background:#f1f5f9;padding:16px;border-radius:8px;max-height:400px;overflow:auto;font-size:12px}.development-panel details{margin:16px 0}.development-panel summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600}.development-panel .button{margin:12px 12px 0 0}.development-run{width:100%;display:grid;gap:6px;text-align:left;border:1px solid #dce4ee;padding:16px;margin:10px 0;border-radius:10px;background:white;color:#172b46;cursor:pointer}.development-run[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:#277b76;background:#f0faf8}.development-run span,.development-run small{color:#53657b}.development-hash{overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:12px}.development-catalog{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}.development-catalog article{padding:18px;border:1px solid #dce4ee;border-radius:10px}.development-catalog small{display:block;margin:8px 0;color:#53657b}.development-catalog p{font-size:13px}@media(max-width:1050px){.development-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.development-catalog{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}@media(max-width:600px){.development-catalog{grid-template-columns:1fr}.development-panel{padding:18px}}
.evaluation-cycle{border-top:1px solid #dde5ef;margin-top:24px;padding-top:24px}.evaluation-cycle h3{font-size:16px}.development-panel table{min-width:530px}.development-panel caption{text-align:left;padding:12px 0;color:#53657b}.development-panel input[type=file]{margin-bottom:20px}
